name: pendulum-swing
description: Signal rhythm analysis kernel. Tracks named signals over time and computes period, amplitude, damping, phase, and forced-vs-free properties.

init.signature: init(dataPath?: string) => { ok: boolean, signals: Signal[] }
init.description: Must be called before any other method. Loads persisted state from disk.

observe.signature: observe(signalId: string, value: number, source: string, ts?: number) => Profile
observe.description: Record a signal observation. Primary intake point. Enforces causal ordering.

profile.description: Get full rhythm profile for a signal. Returns null if signal not found.

signals.description: List all tracked signal IDs with observation counts and timestamps.

compare.signature: compare(signalIdA: string, signalIdB: string) => Comparison | null
compare.description: Compare rhythm properties of two signals. Returns phase delta, period ratio, inPhase, inAntiPhase.

snapshot.description: Export full state as plain object for backup or external persistence.

restore.signature: restore(snapshot: State) => { ok: boolean, signals: Signal[] }
restore.description: Replace state from a snapshot. Validates structure before accepting.

remove.description: Delete a signal and all its observations.

dataQualityLabels.confirmed: Explicit date present in source document
dataQualityLabels.estimated: Inferred from context — treat as provisional

externalConnections.note: Wire any external source to kernel.observe(). No other entry points exist.

files.src/math.js: Pure signal math. No I/O. No side effects.
files.src/store.js: Observation storage. Atomic disk writes. Causality enforcement.
files.src/kernel.js: Public interface. All interaction goes through here.
files.seed.js: Historical seeder. Template for loading dated observations.
files.pendulum-data.json: Persisted signal state. Created on first run.

nextModules.novelty-gate: Sits between signal source and kernel.observe(). Drops observations below delta threshold.
nextModules.adapter-layer: Converts raw signal types (DOM, image, audio, text) to numeric values.
nextModules.clx-causal: Causal graph engine. Receives rhythm profiles as node properties.
nextModules.guardian-listener: BroadcastChannel listener. Pipes Guardian scroll events to adapter layer.
